guard: a second bare down of a controller stack its own down stopped is a no-op without --yes that writes nothing, in every presentation, and a running stack's missing --yes refusal is one line and its remedy
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/space-registration.smoke.ts
why: A second bare down of a stopped controller stack used to refuse for --yes and print the whole usage text, although nothing would stop. The suite drives the built binary through a prepared root's up, down and second down, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: a stack its own down stopped takes the full stop again
mutations.find: if (alreadyStopped(journal0, members)) return nothingRunning(presentation, target, withAgents && values["dry-run"] !== true);
mutations.expectRed: a second bare down without --yes says the stack is not running, names cotal up, and exits 0
mutations.cell: a second bare down without --yes says the stack is not running, names cotal up, and exits 0

mutations.name: the missing --yes refusal prints the command help again
mutations.expectRed: a bare down of the running stack outside a terminal refuses for --yes, with its remedy and without the command help
mutations.cell: a bare down of the running stack outside a terminal refuses for --yes, with its remedy and without the command help
